title: Signal Bento — AM/PM launch day notes
content:
Quick morning capture before standups - messy, personal scratchpad. Use to triage + copy to PRD comments later.

AM (08:45)
- Feeling: slightly behind on PRD acceptance criteria edits. Need to finish the ‘failure modes’ section.
- 09:00 sync w/eng (Amit, Ethan) — confirm canary window length: *2h* OK but want 1.5h minimum. Action: update rollout plan to 90-120m fallback threshold (PRD v1.3).
- 09:30 stakeholder huddle (Legal + Sec) — Legal flagged data retention wording for Private. Need specific KMS line. TODO: add KMS/HSM callout under security requirements. Owner: Sofia. Due: EOD 03/11.

PRD edits notes (to apply directly to PRD doc)
- Title: add shorthand "Bina launch" in parentheses for cross-ref.
- Acceptance criteria: add quantitative latency SLO examples (p95 < 120ms for short seq). Reference internal benchmark RDW-BENCH-2026-02.
- Failure modes: enumerate 3 common paths: model OOM (auto-quant fallback), infra throttling (route to lower-tier model), KV cache miss storm (fallback cold-path with longer tail). Add callouts for observability hooks (trace IDs, trace sampling at 5%).
- Rollout policy: canary 10% -> 30% -> 100% across 3 steps. Insert autoscale guardrail: max burst = 2.5x steady.
- Docs links to add: GH PR #1123 (runtime change), Confluence Launch Playbook.

Follow-ups (short actionable list)
- Ping Amit re: kernel selection test metrics; ask for perf table by 03/12. (E)
- Ask SRE for playbook snippet that covers evicting stale KV cache keys during rollout - include command examples. (SRE)
- Remind Growth to update marketing copy about latency expectations (copy deck link). (Maya)  due 03/13
- Create tiny eval prompt set to validate behavioral parity vs baseline model (10 prompts, 3 prompt families). Owner: me. due 03/11

Launch Day Quick Checklist (scratch, not exhaustive)
- Pre-launch
  - [ ] Finalize PRD v1.3 and push to Confluence (include change log)
  - [x] Merge runtime PR that reduces cold-start by 22% (GH #1123 merged 03/09)
  - [ ] Confirm dedicated capacity can add 20% burst without SLA break (ops confirmation pending)
  - [x] Notify CS and drafting support script (sent 03/10)

- During launch
  - [ ] Monitor p50/p95 latency dashboard (console -> model/bina) every 15m first 2h
  - [ ] Watch error budget burn (alerts at 5%, 10%, 25%)
  - [ ] Verify logs contain trace IDs and route identifiers for sampled requests
  - [ ] Coordinate rollback decision maker (Amit) and comms owner (Maya)

- Post-launch
  - [ ] Write short incident blameless note if any spike > 2x baseline
  - [ ] Run cost delta report for first-day queries

Risks / open concerns
- Pricing blip if autoscale misconfigured; need guardrail that rejects >3x burst on hosted tier without explicit approval.
- Unknown interaction with prefix caching for very long prompt families — need a small stress test with 1k-long prefixes. Owner: Ethan.
- Legal wants explicit data residency line for EU customers; need final text. Owner: Sofia.

Decisions made this morning
- Canary window shortened to 90m minimum after quick perf review.
- Won't include QoS throttle for first canary; we'll rely on capacity routing for now.

Notes to self / random capture
- Quick PRD wording: "system MUST expose per-route token cost estimates" -> add to pricing section.
- Pull in metric RDW-MET-127 (kv-cache hit rate) into daily monitoring dashboard.
- Remember to add test case for function/tool-calling in the eval set.

Unresolved questions
- Should default canary percentage be 10% or 5% for small-scale customers? Tradeoff: safety vs signal. Ask Growth.
- Do we require SOC2 evidence for Private installs by default? Check with security.

Copy-out checklist (what I need to move to PRD + tickets)
- Update PRD: failure modes + KMS callout + acceptance criteria numbers (me)
- Open Jira RDW-3589 for autoscale guardrail (ops)
- Draft SRE runbook snippet and attach to Confluence (SRE)
- Create eval prompt set and attach to PRD (me)

Quick links (for paste)
- PRD (working): https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/INF/Bina+PRD+WIP
- Jira epic: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/RDW-3456
- GH runtime change: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/1123
- Support playbook (skeleton): https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/OPS/Launch+Support+Playbook

End notes: keep this doc as ephemeral scratch. After noon, transfer the PRD action items into the PRD comments and create the RDW tickets. If things calm, write short post-mortem template into Confluence.
